class.name: FoxSocket3D
class.brief_description: A physical 3D location that reparents and holds a single attachment.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is no current attachment.

method.name: get_attachment
method.description: Returns the current attachment node, or [code]null[/code] if empty.

method.name: attach
method.description: Reparents [param new_attachment] to this socket and snaps its transform to [member marker].

method.name: detach
method.description: Safely unplugs the attachment from the socket and returns it. [br][b]Note:[/b] This does not reparent the attachment anywhere else in the scene tree.

members.member: (Optional) The node that will be used for position, rotation, and scale. Leave blank to use this [Marker3D]'s transform.
If [code]true[/code], the attachment's global position snaps to the socket's marker.
If [code]true[/code], the attachment's global rotation snaps to the socket's marker.
If [code]true[/code], the attachment forcefully scales to match the socket marker's global scale.
The child node currently plugged into this socket.

signal.name: attached
signal.description: Emitted when this socket gains a new attachment.

signal.name: detached
signal.description: Emitted when the attachment leaves and is no longer a child.

signal.name: attachment_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the child order changes, useful for detecting deleted attachments.
